notes.title: Introducing Beastiepedia!
notes.content:
Hey Beastie trainer, 

we have a little update for you!
What did we change in the world of Beasties? 

Here we go:
[list]
[*] Collision problems fixed, you could jump outside the runnable area.
[*] AI was turned up and will make less "awkward" moves and more and more sensible attacks
[*] Roglow, skill "Trie Out" could be unnecessarily upgraded, that´s not  longer possible.
[*] Elian Quest, all characters will now return to the village after the final battle! You´re free to explore the world.
[/list]

And now we proudly present our little [url=https://www.rokaplay.com/beasties/beastiepedia]Beastiepedia[/url]! Come over and learn more about your favorite Beastie and which skills might help you during your play through! Ideas or/and feedback? Just jump on our Discord and help us to improve!

notes.title: Finally new languages!
notes.content:
Hey my friends, 

finally we can share new information with you and in addition we have a very special treat!

We are well on our way to submitting Beasties to Nintendo soon! 
This is a big milestone towards Nintendo Switch©️ ahead of us!

notes.title: Update and Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey future Beastie friends!

Small reminder that you can play the beta version on [b][url=https://rokaplay-hq.itch.io/beasties]itch.io[/url][/b]! 
Meanwhile we made an update and some bug fixes!

[url=https://rokaplay-hq.itch.io/beasties][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274329/34c05a1daadb6df2dc09e9c916e8959d4dbfd667.jpg[/img][/url]

- Removed unfitting environment asset 
- Bridge built during the quest "Hard realities" can be crossed now
- Adjusted Would's level when fighting it during the quest "Wounded pride"
- Heal sfx and vfx plays when Elma feeds your Beasties
- Rebalancing of some combats against wild Beasties
- Added particles to area 3
- Started work on skills for 3 new Beasties, however, these are still WIP

notes.title: Beasties Vlog No. 1
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to our first Vlog for Beasties![/b]

We will let you know what´s going on during the developing and of course what our updates contain!
I would say, long story short let´s get started 😋

[url=https://www.loom.com/share/50927dce16c045e190935d8a5ffef403]    
Beasties Vlog 1 - Watch Video
    [img]https://cdn.loom.com/sessions/thumbnails/50927dce16c045e190935d8a5ffef403-with-play.gif[/img]  [/url]

[list]
[*] Lynns position during the quest "Runaway" has been adjusted to avoid players getting stuck inbetween her and the environment.
[*] Collision detection for NPCs has been improved.
[*] Unfinished locas are no longer displayed on computers with non-english or non-german language settings. Instead, English loca is now default with german currently being the only selectable alternative. 
[*] Fixed a bug in which players couldn't close some tutorial screens.
[*] Beasties that join a players' team will now be placed in your inventory and only be sent back to the village once your inventory is full. 
[/list]
Feel free to join us on Discord!
